title: Keamanan, Kualitas & Skalabilitas Data (Data Security, Quality & Scalability)
lead: Menjelaskan enkripsi, kontrol akses, autentikasi, regulasi privasi. Menganalisis mekanisme kontrol + menerapkan optimasi performa.

sections.label: Data Security, Quality & Scalability
sections.title: 1. Keamanan & Privasi
body: Enkripsi: at-rest (AES-256) + in-transit (TLS 1.2+). Hash password dengan bcrypt/Argon2 (jangan MD5/SHA1 polos). Kontrol akses: RBAC + least privilege; masking/tokenisasi PII; audit log. Regulasi: UU PDP No. 27/2022 (Indonesia) — consent, hak hapus, breach notification; padanan: GDPR.
sections.callout: Bahan Bacaan: Kleppmann (2017) Ch.10; Eryurek et al. (2021); UU PDP No.27/2022

sections.label: Data Security, Quality & Scalability
sections.title: 2. Kualitas (lanjutan gov.)
body: Dimensi: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, uniqueness. Implementasikan quality gates di pipeline (tolak/karantina batch gagal) + SLO (mis. freshness < 1 jam, completeness > 99%).

sections.label: Data Security, Quality & Scalability
sections.title: 3. Skalabilitas & Optimasi
body: Skala vertikal vs horizontal; partisi + indeks + materialized view; caching; kompresi kolom (Parquet); autoscaling. Ukur sebelum optimasi: EXPLAIN, profiling, benchmark. UAS = Hasil Proyek (30%): demo pipeline + laporan + presentasi.
sections.callout: Istilah Kunci: AES-256/TLS, RBAC, Masking/Tokenisasi, UU PDP, SLO data quality

sections.label: Implementasi Praktis
sections.title: Contoh Kode & Query
body: Berikut adalah contoh kode atau kueri terkait topik modul ini:
sections.callout:
-- Kontrol akses + masking PII (PostgreSQL)
CREATE ROLE analis LOGIN;
GRANT SELECT ON gold.daily_revenue TO analis;
-- masking: tampilkan hanya 4 digit akhir NIM
SELECT CONCAT('***', RIGHT(nim, 4)) AS nim_masked, ipk FROM mart_akademik;

quiz.question: Enkripsi data at-rest standar…
quiz.explanation: AES-256 + manajemen kunci (KMS); TLS untuk in-transit.

quiz.question: UU PDP Indonesia…
quiz.explanation: Mengatur consent, hak subjek data, notifikasi breach.
